options.title: Netflix Offered Itself to Blockbuster for {fact1}
options.first_line: In two thousand, Netflix offered to sell itself to Blockbuster for {fact1}.
options.first_frame: A Blockbuster rental tape with its blue-and-yellow label pushing in, the Netflix red envelope sliding in beside it.

options.title: Blockbuster Could Have Bought Netflix for {fact1}
options.first_line: Blockbuster could have bought Netflix for {fact1}, and it said no.
options.first_frame: The Blockbuster sign over a video store at night, a red stamp NO landing over it.

options.title: Blockbuster Had {fact3} Stores. Netflix Had an Envelope
options.first_line: Blockbuster had {fact3} stores, and Netflix was a red envelope in the mail.
options.first_frame: A wall of Blockbuster tapes, then a cut to a Netflix envelope in a mailbox.

why: It names two brands everyone knows and makes you ask how a red envelope beat thousands of stores, without the title or first line giving away the offer, the price or the refusal the way A and B do.
